snippet.title: Rakshasa: Official Reveal Trailer | Indian Vampire RPG
snippet.description:
Rakshasa is a first-person, narrative-driven RPG set in modern India, where a hidden world of Tantrik spellcasters and ancient mythological horrors operate on the margins of society. Rakshasa blends brutal turn-based combat with deep roleplaying full of meaningful player choices.

Steeped in India's history and chaotic modernity, Rakshasa is inspired by first-person RPGs like Vampire the Masquerade: Bloodlines and Fallout: New Vegas, as well as top-down classics like Arcanum and Baldur's Gate.

Wishlist on STEAM today!
